basis: All rates were read live from each hotel's own booking engine on 2026-11-27 for exact dates. Prices are dynamic and will change.
seven_night_rule: Primary comparison uses the Feb 15 → Feb 22, 2027 seven-night window. A cell marked 'derived' is the hotel's own displayed nightly rate multiplied by 7 and is explicitly labelled; no tax rate is assumed anywhere.
